name: ExxonMobil Corporation
blurb: ExxonMobil is the largest U.S. integrated oil-and-gas company by market capitalization, operating across upstream exploration and production, downstream refining, chemicals, and an expanding LNG business. Its advantaged asset portfolio — anchored by record Guyana production exceeding 900,000 barrels per day and growing Permian volumes — has made it the go-to large-cap expression of the oil supermajor trade. The company targets $20 billion in structural cost savings by 2030 and has delivered 43 consecutive years of annual dividend growth.
recent: In Q1 2026, ExxonMobil posted adjusted EPS of $1.16, beating consensus by 15% — the largest positive surprise in at least four consecutive quarters — on record Guyana output and $0.6 billion in structural cost reductions. GAAP net income was depressed by $3.9 billion in mark-to-market derivative timing effects that are expected to reverse in subsequent quarters. The Golden Pass LNG terminal loaded its first export cargo in April 2026. Management maintained full-year capex guidance at $27-29 billion and a $20 billion share buyback program. The stock is up sharply year-to-date, buoyed by Brent crude near $130/barrel following the Strait of Hormuz crisis.

sources.title: ExxonMobil Reports Q1 2026 Earnings Amid Hormuz Crisis — TIKR
